propositions: When structured parsing exhausts OUTPUT_RETRIES in _pai_structured's prompted branch, the raw reply text is discarded on terminal raise, preventing replay diagnosis and making schema-blind extraction recurrences unreplayable.

A new optional config key llm.parse_failure_artifact_dir (resolved in LLMConfig via _llm_str, unset by default) enables opt-in capture of the last failed reply as a timestamped artifact file containing response text, model id, contract name, and attempt count.

The artifact write is best-effort and local-only: I/O failures never mask the original parse error, the directory is created if absent, and oldest artifacts are pruned by mtime to keep at most 20 per directory.

The key must be resolved in src/rebar/llm/config.py (RESERVED section, not core config.py) and the write hook is placed immediately before raise last in _pai_structured, reading config via resolve_gate_config.
